div.p: McIntyre Alley comes out of Knox Lane between Little Lonsdale and Lonsdale streets. On 28 March 1876, the Argus reported that on the previous night, John Allen who lived in McIntyre Lane had told the police that another resident of the lane, Margaret Bowden had thrown herself off Princes Bridge into the Yarra. The police dragged the river but could not find her body.
